title: del.in~

messages.description: signal input into the delay line
dummy outlet to force order of execution

arguments.description: sets delay line name (optional, default internal name relative to patch)
delay size in ms or samples

flags.name: -samps
flags.description: sets time value to samples (default is ms)

body:
[del.in~] sets and writes to a delay line. Use [del.out~] to read it. This is quite similar to [delread~]/[delread4~], but with more features.
The -samps flag sets time value to samples instead of ms (default)
The second argument also defines the maximum delay amount a corresponding [del.out~] has.
